title: Console accessibility + i18n audit: keyboard nav, color contrast, and localized UI prototypes
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Summary:
This ticket covers the accessibility and localization (i18n) work needed for three Console surfaces: Dashboards, Rollouts, and Cost views. The focus is on: keyboard navigation flows for interactive widgets, WCAG AA color contrast fixes for charts and badges, and preparing UI text/number/currency surfaces for localization (including RTL layout sanity checks).

Problem statement:
- Keyboard tab order and focus outlines are inconsistent across dashboard cards and rollout toggles, causing discovery issues for keyboard-only users.
- Several token colors (low contrast badges, small text on charts) fall below WCAG AA at smaller sizes and in dark mode.
- UI strings include concatenated tokens that impede translation (e.g., "{value} tokens left"). Number and currency formatting isn't abstracted for locale.

Work completed so far:
- Conducted a lightweight A11Y audit on 2025-01-30 covering the three surfaces; audit notes uploaded to Confluence.
- Created high-fidelity keyboard-nav prototypes in Figma demonstrating linear tab order and explicit skip links for dense card grids.
- Mapped all user-facing strings and currency/number displays into an i18n token spreadsheet; flagged ~14 problematic concatenations.
- Proposed color system adjustments: 3 new semantic color tokens for badge states and 2 chart palette swaps that preserve brand while meeting contrast.

Design decisions / trade-offs:
- Decision: Use visible, persistent focus rings for interactive elements rather than custom invisible outlines to improve discoverability. Trade-off: may slightly change visual rhythm; mitigated by softening ring color to match brand palette.
- Decision: Prefer semantic tokens (e.g., token.badge.positive) and allow per-theme overrides for dark mode instead of hardcoded hex replacements. Trade-off: requires Engineering to add a small theme mapping util (ENG-4299).
- Decision: Avoid changing major dashboard layout to preserve rollout timelines; implement keyboard-first affordances (aria labels, skip links) rather than full structural reflow.

Open items and blockers:
- ENG-4299: theme token runtime mapping needed for dark-mode contrast fixes (blocking final CSS delivery).
- ENG-4305: keyboard focus management library version mismatch; update planned in ENG sprint 2025-W08.
- Need PM sign-off on copy change approach for plurals and tokenization before we lock i18n API shape.

Review notes and feedback (collated):
- Design review (2025-02-04, reviewed by Priya Sharma): "Good direction on focus states; make sure focus color passes APCA/contrast in both light/dark."
- Engineering review (2025-02-10, reviewed by Jamal Reed): "Implementation looks straightforward; request to split color token changes into a small backwards-compatible migration to avoid runtime breakage."
- Accessibility consultant (2025-02-12, Anna Li): "Keyboard flows are much improved. Suggest adding ARIA-live region for dynamic cost updates to announce total changes for screen reader users."

Next steps / action items:
- (Design) Finalize prototype annotations and handoff kit for ENG-4299 (due 2025-02-20).
- (Eng) Implement theme token mapping and chart palette updates (ENG-4299, target PR by 2025-02-22).
- (PM) Approve i18n tokenization strategy and review localization regression plan (PM-792).
- (QA) Create accessibility regression checklist and automated lighthouse scans for dashboards/rollouts/cost pages.

Acceptance criteria:
- Keyboard tab order across dashboard card grids, rollout toggles, and cost filters is linear and predictable; visible focus indicator present on all interactive elements.
- All previously flagged color failures now pass WCAG AA in both light and dark themes for text and UI badges.
- UI strings are tokenized with no concatenated translatable fragments; number & currency formatting consumed from locale-aware util.
- Figma prototypes, Confluence audit, and a GitHub PR with implementation notes exist and are referenced in this ticket.

Signals of completion:
- PR merged for theme tokens and chart palette changes; QA checklist green; localization team confirms translations render correctly for sample locales (en, fr, ja, ar).
